newsitem.title: USA: PACE Health to acquire Wellmark affiliate.
newsitem.headline: PACE Health to acquire Wellmark affiliate.

text.p: PACE Health Management Systems Inc, a patient care software company, said Tuesday it has signed an agreement to acquire substantially all of the assets of Healthcare Software Solutions, LC, an affiliate of Wellmark Inc.
The acquisition price includes 230,000 shares of PACE common Stock, $50,000 cash and a three year royalty payment on all license fees sold during the royalty period, PACE said.

The transaction will be accounted for under the purchase method of accounting and, as a large portion of the purchase is in-process research and development, this will be expensed during the second quarter, PACE said.
Healthcare, headquartered in Des Moines, provides clinical information systems to a wide range of physicians.
